description:
## Return YouTube Username v2.2.2

- Fix complete stream read for og:title: Remove premature buffer cutoff in public resolver to properly extract channel names on all pages.
- Precision channel profile header filtering: Target strictly page_header and profile sheets so comments and Shorts handles are never blocked.
- Full CJK & Unicode Handle resolution: Completely supports Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and international handles in comments and Shorts.
- Pure Standalone Morphe Patch Bundle: Only contains Return YouTube Username without duplicating official patches.
- Zero conflict: seamlessly loads and patches alongside official Morphe patches on Morphe Manager (Android) and Morphe CLI.
- Independent Settings Menu: Dedicated 'Return YouTube Username' screen in Morphe settings.
- Fully compatible with Morphe 2.1.0+ and YouTube 21.30.216.
